_note: Closed registry of proposer/challenger pairs (P8 in strategy/NEXUS-INSTANCE.md). A proposer's work cannot reach any other consumer, a favourable decision or a success closure until a task run by its challenger has recorded a favourable verdict on it. Only the named owner can override a negative verdict, with a reason, evidence and an expiry; an absent verdict cannot be overridden. scripts/check-challenger-pairs.py keeps every runbook that rosters a proposer rostering its challenger too, and keeps each pair out of its excluded runbooks.

pairs.rationale: Investment hypotheses must survive independent validation (point-in-time data, walk-forward, costs, alpha versus beta, stress, paper tracking) before they influence capital.
pairs.excluded_rationale: HTP Annex G: investment-thesis agents stay out of HTP detection, policy and pause paths.
